senses.gloss: pr. n. m.Vespasian, the Roman Emperor who, when general, conducted the war against the Jews which ended in the destruction of the Temple.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 1:19">Targ. Lam. I, 19</cite>.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:14">Sot. IX, 14</cite> <he>פולמוס של א׳</he> the Vespasian war.
